subject: Post-call: approval lane mapping, NDA onboarding & next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@priorityhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: approval lane mapping, NDA onboarding & next steps

Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: inference at edge for clinical decision support for select provider workflows.
- Technical fit: model size and latency targets discussed; Redwood can meet target 150ms p95 with dedicated pools.
- Procurement ask: priorityhealth prefers an initial 12-month term with option to expand.

Key stakeholders we discussed
- Economic buyer: Brandon Lee (Head of Digital Health) — needs cost/ROI math.
- Security/compliance: your InfoSec reviewer (you said you'll loop them in) — expect SOC 2 + DPA review.
- Procurement: you mentioned a centralized procurement queue (procure@priorityhealth.com).

Immediate asks / proposed sequencing
1) NDA first: we typically get mutual NDA in place before sending a detailed SOW and pricing workbook. I attached a short mutual NDA draft for your legal team to review. [Attachment: Redwood_NDA_draft.docx]
2) SOW + quote: attached an MVP SOW + preliminary quote for a 12-month pilot. [Attachment: PriorityHealth_MVP_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_Quote_Q1-2027.xlsx]
3) Decision criteria: can you confirm the top 3 decision criteria for Brandon/execs (e.g., latency, cost per inference, data residency)?

Suggested timeline (flexible)
- Week 0: NDA signed (3–5 business days ideally)
- Week 1–2: Procurement/Legal review SOW & DPA (concurrent)
- Week 2–3: Pilot kickoff after signatures

I'll loop in our security lead (Mina) and my manager (Kimberly) on the thread to make approvals and legal routing clearer. If you can, please share Brandon's preferred cadence for an ROI deck and a preferred contact at procurement.

Thanks — happy to book a follow-up (15–20m) early next week to review the proposed scope.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: Redwood_NDA_draft.docx]
From: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@priorityhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@priorityhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: approval lane mapping, NDA onboarding & next steps

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from our side: 

1) I'll loop Brandon in this afternoon. He typically wants a one-pager on expected savings and a short pricing band before reviewing with execs.
2) Our InfoSec lead (cc'd on follow up when I add them) will ask for SOC 2 Type II and our standard DPA. If you can share SOC 2 report and a DPA template we can compare, that will speed things up.
3) Procurement contact above (procure@priorityhealth.com) will triage the SOW once the NDA is in place. Their SLA is usually 7–10 business days for first-pass redlines.

Can you confirm: is the SOW pricing shown in the spreadsheet list price or pilot discounted rate? Also please confirm target contract length — we'll aim for 12 months as discussed.

I'll get back later today after I add Brandon and InfoSec to the thread.

Regards,
Sofia Morales
Director, Digital Transformation | Priority Health
sofia.morales@priorityhealth.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@priorityhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@priorityhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: approval lane mapping, NDA onboarding & next steps

Thanks Sofia — appreciated. Quick answers and an internal + external plan below.

Pricing: the quote spreadsheet attached is a pilot-discounted price for the 12-month initial commitment. I added a column called "pilot rate" — open to adjust based on final seat counts. [Attachment: Redwood_Quote_Q1-2027.xlsx]

Security artifacts: Mina (cc) will share SOC 2 Type II report and our standard DPA template.

Proposed legal/contract routing (recommended):
- Step 1: NDA signed (mutual, quick turnaround). Owner: PriorityHealth legal & Redwood AE. Target: 3 business days.
- Step 2: Procurement intake (procure@priorityhealth.com) receives SOW + quote; procurement triages commercial terms. Owner: PriorityHealth procurement. Target: 5–10 business days for first-pass redlines.
- Step 3: DPA & MSA redlines in parallel. Owner: PriorityHealth InfoSec & Redwood legal (Mina will own our side). Target: DPA 3–5 business days; MSA redlines 5–7 business days depending on extent.
- Step 4: Exec review & signature (Brandon/finance). Owner: PriorityHealth economic buyer. Target: 3–5 business days.

Mutual action plan (MAP) — minimal version: 
1) Today/Tomorrow: PriorityHealth signs NDA.
2) Within 3 business days of NDA: Procurement triage SOW.
3) Within 1 week: Mina to send SOC 2 + DPA; priorityhealth legal to start MSA redlines.
4) Week 2: Finalize redlines and circulate for exec sign-off.

Mina — can you share SOC 2 & DPA and confirm Redwood's recommended sequencing?

Sofia — happy to book a 20-minute slot Tue/Wed to walk Brandon through the ROI math. What time zone is best?

Best,
Alex
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: PriorityHealth_MVP_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_Quote_Q1-2027.xlsx, Redwood_NDA_draft.docx]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: priorityhealth legal sequencing, owners & blockers

Team — internal note (do not forward externally until we have the NDA signed):

Summary of recommended sequencing (based on similar mid-market healthcare deals):
- NDA first: get mutual in place; send redline window of 3 business days. I have a short mutual NDA ready (attached previously by Alex).
- DPA parallel with MSA commercial redlines: our legal can review DPA in 3 business days; MSA redlines may take two rounds (initial 5 business days, rebuttal 3 business days).
- Procurement typically asks for a single consolidated commercial redline doc — we should track their comments in one document to avoid churn.

Owners (internal):
- NDA & DPA: Mina (legal/security) — I will push SOC 2 report and our DPA template once external NDA is in place.
- Pricing/Commercial concessions: Kimberly (sales manager) to approve up to 15% pilot discount; anything beyond routed to VP sales.
- Technical due diligence & pilot ops: Stephanie to own runbook and pilot acceptance criteria.

Potential blockers to call out: 
- Data residency: if PriorityHealth insists on EMEA-only residency for some PHI subsets we will need to confirm hosting region and encryption-at-rest options — this could add 2–3 weeks.
- DPA negotiation on subprocessors: if they require elimination of certain subprocessors, expect extended legal discussions.

Proposed internal timeline (conservative):
- NDA: 3 business days after we send revised mutual copy.
- Procurement first-pass: 7–10 business days.
- MSA & DPA close: 2–3 weeks total assuming no unusual data residency demands.

Action items: 
1) Alex: send final NDA draft to PriorityHealth today and request 3-business-day turnaround.
2) Kimberly: review and confirm approval band for pilot discount by EOD today.
3) Stephanie: prepare pilot acceptance criteria doc and one-page runbook for procurement.

I'll stand by to drop SOC 2 artifacts into DocuSign/file share once NDA is fully executed.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
